hero.subtitle: CICLOVELA ensures transparency, price integrity, and unbroken inventory records for agricultural products. Trace your food quality today.

landing.aboutP1: Agricultural supply chains are often too long and opaque. Prices skyrocket at the consumer level while farmers earn minimal profit. Moreover, nobody knows when a tomato was actually harvested.
landing.aboutP2: CICLOVELA was born to break this chain of ignorance. With a batch-based inventory system and an immutable ledger, every handover from farmer to distributor to store is recorded permanently.
landing.side1d: Every transaction locked by the system
landing.howSub: A transparent workflow that guarantees the integrity of every agricultural commodity.
landing.step1d: Farmers register product batches complete with expiry dates.
landing.step2d: Authorized distributors buy and record goods movement (Inbound).
landing.step3d: Retailers buy stock and record waste disposal (if any).
landing.step4d: Buyers check goods history via code to verify authenticity.
landing.feat1d: All transaction and stock movement data is permanent and cannot be manipulated once confirmed.
landing.feat2d: Secure history tracking (Traceability) that only shows public journey data without leaking price margins.
landing.feat3d: Expired or damaged product (Waste) recording directly connected to automatic inventory deduction.
landing.faq1a: CICLOVELA is a B2B and B2C agricultural supply chain platform that lets you trace product journeys from farmers and distributors to your hands.
landing.faq2a: Our system is designed for Farmers, Distributor companies, Retailer stores, and end consumers who want to verify product authenticity and freshness.
landing.faq3a: Each harvest receives a unique Batch ID. Just enter that ID on the Track Product page, and the system shows the immutable chain of goods movement.
landing.faq4a: For now, basic usage is completely free in support of Indonesian agricultural digitalization.
landing.footerDesc: Batch-Based Agricultural Supply Chain Recording System. Bringing trust back to your dining table.
